decision.explanation: Document D1 (segments D1S3-D1S4, D1S21-D1S22) explicitly identifies 'Piers W. Dent' as the spouse of Lady Katherine Ann Townshend, citing Peerage person ID 62667. Document D2 presents a fantastical, physically impossible scenario involving 'Rebecca Woodward' (a deceased 19th-century socialite) and claims of time travel/quantum entanglement. Per the instruction to treat documents as fallible and not to accept absurdities as truth, D2 is rejected as a hallucination or fiction. The only valid, grounded answer is Piers W. Dent.
